ABBA, c’est l’Alliance des Bâtisseurs Bi: ABBA is the Alliance of Biblical Builders in Action, a Christian holistic development organization based in Cotonou, Benin.
Nous croyons que Dieu veut voir chaque p: We believe that God wants every person to be well provided for in everything that contributes to life and godliness: health, education, profession, finance, family and faith. You do not fix one area by letting the others collapse, which is why we work on all of them at once.
Le Parcours Bâtisseur est la formation d: The Builder Course is ABBA’s training. It lasts six months to finish the 15 modules, followed by six more months of Taking Action, where you apply what you have learned with support.
Chaque module suit les mêmes quatre étap: Every module follows the same four steps: the reading, the questions (70% correct answers to move on), the exercises, then the sheet you send to your corrector. They validate it or send it back with a comment. The next module opens when the previous one is validated.
Le modèle de l’Homme Fait: The model of the Complete Man
Le Parcours forme ce que nous appelons l: The Course shapes what we call the Complete Man: a balanced builder who grows in eight areas at once.
: une relation solide avec Dieu (foi, do: : a solid relationship with God (faith, doctrine, salvation, deliverance).
: maîtriser ses pensées et ses émotions: : mastering your thoughts and emotions (emotional control, discipline, decision-making).
: garder une santé robuste (prévention,: : keeping robust health (prevention, care, hygiene, well-being).
: assurer ses besoins fondamentaux (loge: : meeting your basic needs (housing, food, clothing, transport).
: acquérir les connaissances essentielle: : acquiring essential knowledge (reading, writing, digital tools).
: exercer une activité stable, emploi, e: : carrying out a stable activity: employment, business or ministry.
: gérer ses ressources avec sagesse (épa: : managing your resources wisely (saving, investing, financial independence).
: être un acteur bénéfique pour son ento: : being a positive presence for those around you (commitment, civic spirit, respect for the law and for the principles of the Kingdom).
